title: Broad Summer Research Program (BSRP)
institution: Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard
field: Physical, biological or computer sciences, engineering and mathematics
level: Undergraduate students (see official page for eligibility)
about: The Broad Institute's 2027 Summer Research Program is for non-graduating undergraduates at four-year U.S. institutions. Applicants submit an online form, five short essays, transcripts, a CV and two letters of recommendation. Applications close on 10 January 2027.
requirements: Enrolled at a four-year U.S. institution, graduation date of December 2027 or later (per official FAQ)
Legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of applying

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "Broad Summer Research Program" (undergraduate research) → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

"five short essays, transcripts, a CV and two letters of recommendation" (written application) → "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management."
